title: Top 50 TEs in 3-D: CONTESTED-CATCH KINGS
parts:
🧲 TEs in 3-D: contested-catch kings

→ Left to right: average depth of target
↑ Bottom to top: contested-catch rate
🎨 Color: yards per route run

Only 27 of the top 50 TEs have 6+ contested targets, so small samples, said plainly.

Winning the 50/50s:

Marshall Pritchett (Alabama, SO): 6 for 6
Nate Roberts (Ohio State, SO): 5 of 6 at a 10.8-yd aDOT
Eli Finley (Louisiana Tech): 10 of 13
Caleb Odom (Ole Miss): 8 of 11 at an 11.4-yd aDOT
Kari Ashley (TCU): 7 of 12, tied for the chart-best 2.63 YPRR

Deepest target on the chart: Daunte Bacheyie (Syracuse, SO), 11.9 yds, 5 of 13 on contested balls
